description: Use when the user asks for an overview of a 1:250k map area ('areas'), a geological province ('provinces'), a commodity ('commodities') or a Minedex mine or deposit ('mines'), built from the platform's own data. Without slug: returns the summaries of that kind whose name matches q, with their report and Minedex counts. With slug: returns that summary's figures (reports by decade, commodities and operators by report count, Minedex sites, training sites...) and its sources.

q.description: Part of a name or code (e.g. "kalgoorlie", "SH51-09", "gold").

slug.description: A page's slug from an earlier answer.

name: get_place_summary
title: Get a place summary
